actions.label: 󰤨  Wi-Fi
actions.command: bash -lc 'if [[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" == true ]]; then nmcli radio wifi on; else nmcli radio wifi off; fi'
actions.update-command: bash -lc '[[ "$(nmcli radio wifi)" == enabled ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: 󰂯  BT
actions.command: bash -lc 'if [[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" == true ]]; then bluetoothctl power on; else bluetoothctl power off; fi'
actions.update-command: bash -lc 'bluetoothctl show 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Powered: yes" && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: 󰖙  Power
actions.command: bash -lc 'if [[ "$SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE" == true ]]; then $HOME/.local/bin/pixelrail-profile performance; else $HOME/.local/bin/pixelrail-profile battery; fi'
actions.update-command: bash -lc '[[ "$(cat "$HOME/.cache/pixelrail/profile" 2>/dev/null)" == performance ]] && echo true || echo false'
